source.title: Initializing ReLU networks in an expressive subspace of weights

record.file_problem: Full paper text supplied; no truncation or document mismatch apparent.
record.tranche_reason: The paper trains ReLU networks from several initializations in teacher-student tasks and reports validation-loss outcomes. This is a different measure and setting from the claim versions, but it tests initialization effects on training dynamics relevant to V4.
record.gate_note: The paper also reports signal length, correlation, and dead-node measurements, but these are not training-error results named by the versions. Training-task plots report validation loss; no exact training classification error is reported. No rows are recorded for the cited prior studies.
record.test_reason: The study compares learning curves under different initializations in plain ReLU teacher-student networks, bearing on V4's initialization-dependent learning speed. It does not establish greater trainable depth or directly measure gradient preservation.
record.authors_conclusion: The record's paraphrase is broadly accurate. The authors conclude that anti-correlations create a bounded chaotic phase and can accelerate learning, and that combining anti-correlations with asymmetric initialization yields RAAI's strongest advantage, especially early with SGD. They acknowledge task- and optimizer-dependent outcomes, ACI's intermediate SGD difficulty on complex tasks, and deeper-network overfitting. Their local-minimum explanation is a hypothesis.
record.recipe_differences: Uses correlated, asymmetric, and combined initializations in fully connected teacher-student regression tasks; reports validation loss rather than benchmark classification training error.
record.method_sensitivity: Relative performance of RAI and ACI varies by task and optimizer; ACI's intermediate performance on the complex teacher task is poor with SGD but not similarly so with Adam. Deeper ACI networks overfit; reducing correlation strength k can avoid this. RAAI is reported to have no overfitting signs in the deeper networks described.

fits_no_version.finding: ACI overfits in the reported 20-layer experiment; reducing correlation strength avoids it, while RAAI shows no reported overfitting.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Initialization affects generalization in deeper teacher-student networks.

record.problems: The evidence uses teacher-student regression tasks and validation loss, not classification training error. Training outcomes are shown in figures without exact numerical values in the text. No CIFAR benchmarks or random/corrupted labels are tested.
record.rows_left_out: No additional eligible training-task outcomes identified. Signal-propagation plots and dead-node probabilities are initialization measurements, not the training outcomes named by the versions.

untested.parts: CIFAR training classification error, random or corrupted labels, model-size effects, and regularization effects.
Two-layer teacher-student width sweeps and measured frequencies of spurious local minima; the authors' local-minimum explanation is conjectural.
Depth degradation in plain convolutional networks and comparisons with residual shortcuts.

Greater trainable depth, direct gradient-preservation measurements, comparisons across activation functions, orthogonal versus Gaussian initialization, and very deep tanh or convolutional networks. Validation learning curves do not isolate signal preservation as the cause of faster optimization.
Learning-rate stability thresholds, curvature dynamics, recovery after loss increases, and divergence.

missing.what: ACI, He, and positively correlated initialization learning curves for both optimizers: ACI learns faster on the standard task, positive correlations learn slower, and simple-task SGD initially shows equal performance before ACI gains an advantage.

Complex-task comparisons showing ACI's worse intermediate performance with SGD and dependence of the poorly performing interval on task complexity. Record the optimizer-specific comparisons without treating the conjectured local minima as measured.

record.verdict_notes: The study is not an original source listed for V4. No exact curve values can be recovered from the supplied text. ACI overfitting does not demonstrate an optimization failure, and on-par validation performance does not demonstrate a strict speed gain.

versions.untested_parts: No CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100 classification, corrupted or random labels, or training classification error is reported.
No two-layer teacher-student neuron-count sweep or spurious-local-minima frequency test.
No plain-versus-residual architecture comparison or depth sweep testing shortcuts.

Tests correlated, asymmetric, and combined ReLU initializations in a fully connected teacher-student setting; does not test activation-matched initialization families, orthogonal versus Gaussian weights, or very deep convolutional networks.
No learning-rate stability threshold or sharpness measurement.
